name: kois-gallery
description: Self-hosted photo delivery platform for photographers.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/web && npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix landing
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run sync:web && npm run build:api
scripts.test:web:e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.format:check: npm run format:api:check && npm run format:web:check && npm run format:landing:check
